report.root_cause: Player ShadowPhantom99 (new account, joined 06:47:16, given Creative mode) systematically broke 33 minecraft:oak_planks blocks of another player's build in world at x 8-14, y -60..-56, z 8 (adjacent to Steve_Mines at 2.5,-60,8.5) between 12:47:19Z and 12:47:58Z, placing nothing. Evidence: plugins/BlockLog/blocks.csv (all break rows attributed to ShadowPhantom99).
report.actions: 1) Baseline status/logs check (healthy). 2) Noticed Mira_Crafts and ShadowPhantom99 join; read plugins/BlockLog/blocks.csv and found ShadowPhantom99 breaking a row-by-row oak_planks wall while Mira_Crafts only placed cobblestone on her own plot (-22..-17, z20-21). Confirmed positions via 'data get entity ... Pos'. 3) Called declare_incident. 4) Console: 'ban ShadowPhantom99 Griefing: ...' — player disconnected; subsequent reconnect attempts (06:48:40, 06:48:56, 06:50:12) rejected by the ban. 5) Re-read blocks.csv for the complete list of 33 broken blocks and restored them with five 'execute in minecraft:overworld run fill ... minecraft:oak_planks replace minecraft:air' commands (8-10/-60, 12-14/-60, 8-10/-59, 12-14/-59, 8-14/-58..-56 at z=8) — 3+3+3+3+21 = 33 blocks filled; x=11 at y-60/-59 was never broken so left untouched. Used 'replace air' so no later-placed blocks were overwritten. 6) Verified with 'execute if block'/'if blocks' tests (all passed, 21/21 for the big region), confirmed no new BlockLog break events, players online are only the 3 legitimate ones, TPS 20, plugins all enabled. 7) Watched ~45 s more; no recurrence. No restart, no files deleted or written.
report.residual_risk: Server is in offline-mode (no username authentication), so the griefer can return under a different name; ban is by name/UUID only, not IP (same 127.0.0.1 as legitimate players, so an IP ban was not appropriate). Restored planks used default block state — if the original wall had non-default orientation/variants, minor cosmetic differences are possible (BlockLog records only block type). ShadowPhantom99 was still in Creative at ban time, irrelevant while banned but would need resetting if ever unbanned. Mira_Crafts remains in Creative mode as set via RCON before my shift (intended change, left as is).
